cohorts.common_applied: All nine exact same-fault configuration outcomes known and applied==true.
cohorts.all_known: All nine same-fault outcomes known, without requiring applied.
cohorts.clean_success_common_applied: Primary common_applied cohort plus all nine same-task/repeat clean outcomes known and successful.

definitions.four_states: First digit baseline success, second digit candidate success: 00 persistent failure,01 rescue,10 regression,11 retained success.
definitions.rescue_overlap: Within the same baseline-failure set: both Flat change and alternative-model change rescue, Flat only, model only, neither.
definitions.pooled_weighting: Unit-weighted observed five-fault mixture; fault identity is always retained in joins. Not a common semantic operator across domains.

bootstrap.method: Domain-stratified task-cluster percentile bootstrap; sample the original number of scheduled tasks with replacement within each domain; retain all eligible repeats, conditions and nine configurations of each sampled task together.
bootstrap.scope: Only all-domain/all-five-fault major summaries; no per-cell significance tests or multiplicity claims.
